name: io.github.moxzas/productbrain
title: ProductBrain
description: Drive a ProductBrain product plan (goals, needs, approaches, jobs) from your agent: search, read, mutate, run the methodology workflow, steer the live view. Thin transport over the versioned v1 REST API.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTBRAIN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your pb_ API key (Settings → API Keys in the app; the free tier includes API access).

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTBRAIN_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default project id. Optional; every tool also accepts projectId.

environmentVariables.name: PRODUCTBRAIN_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://productbrain.com/api/v1.
